crossRefs.note: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
“Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

translations.web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
translations.bsb: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.
translations.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
translations.asv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
